reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

fixture.providerMode: dedicated local OpenID Connect fixture; full browser authorization and callback; no external identity-provider account

steps.action: A genuinely fresh instance offers setup Help that reaches the first-run guide
steps.actual: On an instance still reporting needsSetup true, "Help with this page" on Set up OpenLaw opened the formal reader at the setup topic and the first-run guide was reachable and rendered its H1.

steps.action: Setup refuses mismatched passwords and a short password, then creates the first Administrator
steps.actual: A seven-character password left the Password field invalid and stayed on Set up OpenLaw; a mismatch raised "The passwords do not match."; the corrected submission signed Devon Ashcroft in as first Administrator and opened Welcome to OpenLaw.

steps.action: Welcome offers its own contextual Help before onboarding is finished
steps.actual: The unfinished wizard exposed "Help with this page", which opened the same formal setup topic listing the first-run guide; returning to /welcome still showed the wizard.

steps.action: Unregistered OIDC cannot be selected; built-in sign-in continues to the portal step
steps.actual: Selecting Single sign-on (OIDC) with no provider was refused with "Register an identity provider before switching to single sign-on."; Built-in sign-in continued to the step titled Business-user portal.

steps.action: Portal step saves two allowed domains entered without an email username
steps.actual: Add accepted the bare domains helix.example and northwind.example, each gaining a Remove control; Continue saved them and opened Outbound email. The API read back exactly those two saved domains.

steps.action: Reloading the unfinished wizard returns to Welcome and keeps saved settings
steps.actual: A reload dropped the current step back to Welcome, as the guide states; Get started then Continue showed both saved domains still present, so saved settings survived while the step position did not.

steps.action: Set up later on a middle step skips only that step and does not finish onboarding
steps.actual: Set up later on Business-user portal moved to Outbound email and stayed inside the wizard; the onboarding record still reported completed false, confirming a middle-step skip is not the finishing action.

steps.action: Outbound email starts unset, rejects a non-SMTP relay, and saves a working relay
steps.actual: The step opened on "Outbound email is not set up."; an https:// relay was refused and left the source unset; smtp://mailpit:1025 with a From address saved, switched the pane to Replace relay, stopped showing the relay URL again, and moved the resolved source to app.

steps.action: Send test email delivers a real SMTP message to the signed-in Administrator
steps.actual: Send test email reported "Test email sent" and a real message reached Devon Ashcroft in the fixture Mailpit inbox, so a saved relay was confirmed by delivery rather than by the save alone.
